verdict.rationale: The Server Administration Guide documents built-in per-realm SCIM endpoints for managing users and groups, with setup steps for enabling SCIM, getting the base URL and creating a service account client. This lets customer directories push users and groups into Keycloak. Missing for 10: documented deprovisioning semantics (whether a SCIM delete or deactivate disables the user and revokes active sessions and tokens), detail on group membership sync behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SCIM feature.
